post.title: Your $5.99 Twitch sub: how much the streamer gets
post.ig:
In 2026, Twitch keeps about half of most streamers' $5.99 subs.

Twitch's default split is 50/50 of net sub revenue. Its Plus Program pays 60/40 at 100 Plus Points and 70/30 at 300, held for 3 months (gifted subs don't count).
Hypothetical: 100 Tier 1 subs = $599 a month: $299.50 at 50/50, $359.40 at 60/40 (100 Plus Points), before taxes and fees.
Bits: viewers pay about $1.40 for 100 Bits; the streamer gets $1. Ads pay 55% with 3+ ad minutes an hour.
YouTube memberships pay creators 70%; Kick says creators keep 95% of subs.

Sources: Twitch Help and Twitch Blog (2023-2024); YouTube Help; Kick; Stream Hatchet 2025 report.
